expected: the 48 regulators of L3 imply a signed gene footprint; each gene's expected direction is action (lower, -1) x path sign x sign(tfmode). Weight unweighted (P7, w=1), as in the CollecTRI trace.
observed: 4437 footprint genes in the LINCS gene space; 3695 carry a signed expectation (991 UP, 2704 DOWN), 742 conflicted between this unit's own regulators and excluded. Attribution: median 14.0 regulators in the whole COADREAD network claim each signed gene; 0.1% of signed genes are claimed by exactly one. Structural hub E2F1 claims 0.120 of the signed genes over 48 contributing regulators.
provenance: data/processed/lincs/trace_aracne/aracne_regulon_edges.tsv.gz, network COADREAD (viper::aracne2regulon on the cohort's TCGA tumour matrix, scripts/44_aracne_regulons.R); action sign from D121 units.tsv
independence: same regulon as L3 - one source, reported twice. AND, unlike the CollecTRI trace: an ARACNe regulon IS learned from tumour co-expression, which is the source L7's tumour contrast uses and the source L2's O component uses when it is a NES. The D133.1 entanglement that did NOT apply to CollecTRI DOES apply here - L4 and L7 are not independent.
concentration: structural: largest single regulator (E2F1) claims 0.120 of the 3695 signed genes, over 48 contributing regulators.
alternatives: attribution: 99.9% of signed genes are claimed by other regulators in COADREAD too.
conflicted genes are dropped rather than counted against the prediction.

ARACNe tfmode is the SIGN OF A CORRELATION across that cohort's tumours, not a measured direction of regulation. A gene expected DOWN is a gene that co-varies positively with the regulator in tumours; a drug that moves the cell along the same axis for any reason will satisfy the prediction.
the regulon is COADREAD-specific: the same target in a different cohort would get a different footprint from the same signalling route.
